ACTION.NAME: READ_BY_WORKORDER_NUMBER
ACTION.STATEMENT: select wo.WorkOrderNum,wo.RouteId,rd.OperationNumber,rd.OperationId,roop.ParamName,roop.ParamSequence,roop.ParamType ,case roop.ParamType when 'int' then CAST(woop.ParamValueInt as varchar(max)) when 'float' then CAST(woop.ParamValueFloat as varchar(max)) when 'varchar' then isnull(woop.ParamValueVarchar,'') else null end AS ParamValue, '' as EmployeeId from WorkOrder wo WITH (NOLOCK) inner join RouteDetail rd WITH (NOLOCK) on rd.RouteId=wo.RouteId inner join WorkOrderOperation woo WITH (NOLOCK) on wo.WorkOrderNum=woo.WorkOrderNum and rd.RouteId=woo.RouteId and rd.OperationNumber=woo.OperationNumber and rd.OperationId=woo.OperationId inner join RouteOperationOutputParametrics roop WITH (NOLOCK) on roop.RouteId=wo.RouteId and roop.OperationNumber=rd.OperationNumber and roop.OperationId=rd.OperationId left outer join WorkOrderOperationParametrics woop WITH (NOLOCK) on woop.WorkOrderNum=wo.WorkOrderNum and woop.RouteId=roop.RouteId and woop.OperationNumber=roop.OperationNumber and woop.OperationId=roop.OperationId and woop.ParamName=roop.ParamName where (wo.WorkOrderNum in @WorkOrderNumbers or wo.WorkOrderNum like @WorkOrderNumberWildCard or wo.OriginalWorkOrder in @OriginalWorkOrders or wo.OriginalWorkOrder like @OriginalWorkOrderWildCard) and wo.Status='ACTIVE' and woo.CompleteDate is null order by rd.Sequence,roop.ParamSequence

ACTION.NAME: XREAD_BY_WORKORDERNUMBER
ACTION.STATEMENT: select WorkOrder.WorkOrderNum,RouteDetail.RouteId,WorkOrderOperation.OperationNumber,WorkOrderOperation.OperationId,convert(varchar,WorkOrderOperation.StartDate,22) as StartDate,convert(varchar,WorkOrderOperation.CompleteDate,22) as CompleteDate,case when WorkOrderOperation.PassFail=1 then 'Pass' when WorkOrderOperation.PassFail=0 then 'Fail' else '' end as PassFail,PartMaster.EWO,WorkOrderOperation.EmployeeId,convert(varchar,WorkOrderOperation.LastUpdateDate,22) as LastUpdateDate FROM WorkOrder WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN RouteDetail WITH (NOLOCK) ON RouteDetail.RouteId = WorkOrder.RouteId INNER JOIN WorkOrderOperation WITH (NOLOCK) ON WorkOrder.WorkOrderNum = WorkOrderOperation.WorkOrderNum AND RouteDetail.RouteId = WorkOrderOperation.RouteId AND RouteDetail.OperationNumber = WorkOrderOperation.OperationNumber AND RouteDetail.OperationId = WorkOrderOperation.OperationId INNER JOIN PartMaster WITH (NOLOCK) ON PartMaster.PartId = WorkOrder.PartId INNER JOIN PartNumber WITH (NOLOCK) ON PartMaster.PartNumber = PartNumber.PartNumber AND PartMaster.PartNumberRev = PartNumber.PartNumberRev where WorkOrder.WorkOrderNum like @WorkOrderNumbers order by RouteDetail.Sequence

ACTION.NAME: READ_BY_WORKORDERNUMBERS
ACTION.STATEMENT: select top 1000 WorkOrder.WorkOrderNum,RouteDetail.RouteId,WorkOrderOperation.OperationNumber,WorkOrderOperation.OperationId,convert(varchar,WorkOrderOperation.StartDate,22) as StartDate,convert(varchar,WorkOrderOperation.CompleteDate,22) as CompleteDate,case when WorkOrderOperation.PassFail=1 then 'Pass' when WorkOrderOperation.PassFail=0 then 'Fail' else '' end as PassFail,PartMaster.EWO,WorkOrderOperation.EmployeeId,convert(varchar,WorkOrderOperation.LastUpdateDate,22) as LastUpdateDate,isnull(woof.FmaResult,'') as FmaId FROM WorkOrder WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN RouteDetail WITH (NOLOCK) ON RouteDetail.RouteId = WorkOrder.RouteId INNER JOIN WorkOrderOperation WITH (NOLOCK) ON WorkOrder.WorkOrderNum = WorkOrderOperation.WorkOrderNum AND RouteDetail.RouteId = WorkOrderOperation.RouteId AND RouteDetail.OperationNumber = WorkOrderOperation.OperationNumber AND RouteDetail.OperationId = WorkOrderOperation.OperationId INNER JOIN PartMaster WITH (NOLOCK) ON PartMaster.PartId = WorkOrder.PartId INNER JOIN PartNumber WITH (NOLOCK) ON PartMaster.PartNumber = PartNumber.PartNumber AND PartMaster.PartNumberRev = PartNumber.PartNumberRev LEFT JOIN WorkOrderOperationFma woof ON woof.WorkOrderNum=WorkOrder.WorkOrderNum AND woof.RouteId=WorkOrderOperation.RouteId AND woof.OperationNumber=WorkOrderOperation.OperationNumber AND woof.OperationId=WorkOrderOperation.OperationId where (WorkOrder.WorkOrderNum in @WorkOrderNumbers or WorkOrder.WorkOrderNum like @WorkOrderNumberWildCard) order by WorkOrder.WorkOrderNum,RouteDetail.Sequence,OperationNumber

ACTION.NAME: READ_BY_PARTID
ACTION.STATEMENT: select WorkOrder.WorkOrderNum,RouteDetail.RouteId,RouteDetail.OperationNumber,RouteDetail.OperationId,RouteOperationBOM.PartNumber,RouteOperationBOM.PartNumberRev,BOMPN.Description as DescriptionBOM,RouteOperationBOM.Quantity,WorkOrder.PartId as AssemblyPartId,AssyPN.PartId,AssyPN.Quantity as Lot,'' as EmployeeId FROM WorkOrder WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN RouteDetail WITH (NOLOCK) ON RouteDetail.RouteId=WorkOrder.RouteId INNER JOIN WorkOrderOperation WITH (NOLOCK) ON WorkOrder.WorkOrderNum=WorkOrderOperation.WorkOrderNum AND RouteDetail.RouteId=WorkOrderOperation.RouteId AND RouteDetail.OperationNumber=WorkOrderOperation.OperationNumber AND RouteDetail.OperationId=WorkOrderOperation.OperationId INNER JOIN PartMaster WITH (NOLOCK) ON PartMaster.PartId=WorkOrder.PartId INNER JOIN PartNumber WITH (NOLOCK) ON PartMaster.PartNumber=PartNumber.PartNumber AND PartMaster.PartNumberRev=PartNumber.PartNumberRev INNER JOIN RouteOperationBOM WITH (NOLOCK) ON RouteOperationBOM.RouteId=WorkOrder.RouteId AND RouteOperationBOM.OperationNumber=RouteDetail.OperationNumber AND RouteOperationBOM.OperationId=RouteDetail.OperationId AND RouteOperationBOM.SapGoodsIssue=0 INNER JOIN BOM WITH (NOLOCK) ON BOM.PartNumber=PartMaster.PartNumber AND BOM.PartNumberRev=PartMaster.PartNumberRev AND BOM.Drawing=RouteOperationBOM.PartNumber AND BOM.DrawingRev=RouteOperationBOM.PartNumberRev INNER JOIN [dbo].[UDF_RouteOperationBomMaxPartNumberRev] () as RouteOperationBomMaxPartNumberRev ON RouteOperationBomMaxPartNumberRev.RouteId = WorkOrder.RouteId AND RouteOperationBomMaxPartNumberRev.OperationNumber=RouteDetail.OperationNumber AND RouteOperationBomMaxPartNumberRev.OperationId=RouteDetail.OperationId AND RouteOperationBomMaxPartNumberRev.PartNumber=BOM.Drawing AND RouteOperationBomMaxPartNumberRev.PartNumberRev=BOM.DrawingRev INNER JOIN PartNumber BOMPN WITH (NOLOCK)ON BOMPN.PartNumber=RouteOperationBOM.PartNumber AND BOMPN.PartNumberRev=RouteOperationBOM.PartNumberRev LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT PartAssembly.AssemblyPartId,PartAssembly.Quantity,PartMaster.PartNumber AS AssyPartNumber,PartMaster.PartNumberRev AS AssyPartNumberRev,PartAssembly.PartId,PartAssembly.PartId + '(' + convert(varchar,PartAssembly.Quantity) + ')' PartIdQty,PartMaster_1.PartNumber,PartMaster_1.PartNumberRev,WorkOrder.WorkOrderNum FROM PartAssembly WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN PartMaster ON PartAssembly.AssemblyPartId=PartMaster.PartId INNER JOIN WorkOrder WITH (NOLOCK) ON WorkOrder.PartId=PartMaster.PartId INNER JOIN PartMaster AS PartMaster_1 ON PartAssembly.PartId=PartMaster_1.PartId) AS AssyPN ON AssyPN.WorkOrderNum=WorkOrder.WorkOrderNum AND AssyPN.PartNumber=BOM.Drawing WHERE WorkOrder.Status = 'ACTIVE' and WorkOrderOperation.CompleteDate is null and (WorkOrder.WorkOrderNum in @WorkOrderNumbers or WorkOrder.WorkOrderNum like @WorkOrderNumberWildCard or WorkOrder.OriginalWorkOrder in @OriginalWorkOrders or WorkOrder.OriginalWorkOrder like @OriginalWorkOrderWildCard)

ACTION.NAME: READ_BY_WORKORDER_NUMBER
ACTION.STATEMENT: WITH CurrentOperation AS ( SELECT woo.WorkOrderNum, woo.Sequence, convert(varchar,woo.StartDate,22) as StartDate,convert(varchar,woo.CompleteDate,22) as CompleteDate, case when woo.PassFail=1 then 'Pass' when woo.PassFail=0 then 'Fail' else '' end as PassFail, woo.EmployeeId, woo.LastUpdateDate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wo.OriginalWorkOrder ORDER BY woo.LastUpdateDate DESC,woo.Sequence DESC) AS rn FROM WorkOrderOperation woo WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN WorkOrder wo on wo.WorkOrderNum=Woo.WorkOrderNum WHERE woo.CompleteDate is not null and woo.PassFail=0 ) SELECT top 1000 wo.WorkOrderNum, co.Sequence, pm.PartNumber, pm.PartNumberRev, pn.Description, rd.RouteId, rd.OperationNumber, rd.OperationId, pm.EWO, woof.FmaResult as FmaId, case when fs.Url is null then woof.Url else fs.url+'/show_bug.cgi?id='+woof.FmaResult end as FmaUrl, wo.OriginalWorkOrder, co.StartDate, co.CompleteDate, co.PassFail, co.EmployeeId, co.LastUpdateDate, pm.PartStatus FROM CurrentOperation co INNER JOIN WorkOrder wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.WorkOrderNum=co.WorkOrderNum INNER JOIN RouteDetail rd WITH (NOLOCK) ON rd.RouteId=wo.RouteId and rd.OperationNumber=co.Sequence and InactiveDate is null INNER JOIN PartMaster pm WITH (NOLOCK) ON pm.PartId=wo.PartId INNER JOIN PartNumber pn WITH (NOLOCK) ON pm.PartNumber=pn.PartNumber AND pm.PartNumberRev=pn.PartNumberRev LEFT JOIN WorkOrderOperationFma woof ON woof.WorkOrderNum=wo.WorkOrderNum AND woof.RouteId=rd.RouteId AND woof.OperationNumber=rd.OperationNumber AND woof.OperationId=rd.OperationId LEFT JOIN FmaServer fs WITH (NOLOCK) ON fs.FmaServer=woof.url WHERE co.rn = 1 and (wo.OriginalWorkOrder in @WorkOrderNumbers or wo.OriginalWorkOrder like @WorkOrderNumberWildCard) and wo.Status = 'Completed' and not exists(select 1 from workorder woa where woa.OriginalWorkOrder=wo.OriginalWorkOrder and woa.Status='Active') order by wo.OriginalWorkOrder

ACTION.NAME: READ_BY_WORKORDER_NUMBER
ACTION.STATEMENT: WITH CurrentOperation AS ( SELECT woo.WorkOrderNum, woo.Sequence, convert(varchar,woo.StartDate,22) as StartDate,convert(varchar,woo.CompleteDate,22) as CompleteDate, case when woo.PassFail=1 then 'Pass' when woo.PassFail=0 then 'Fail' else '' end as PassFail, woo.EmployeeId, woo.LastUpdateDate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wo.OriginalWorkOrder ORDER BY woo.LastUpdateDate DESC,woo.Sequence DESC) AS rn FROM WorkOrderOperation woo WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN WorkOrder wo on wo.WorkOrderNum=Woo.WorkOrderNum WHERE wo.OriginalWorkOrder in @WorkOrderNumbers ) SELECT top 1000 wo.WorkOrderNum, co.Sequence, pm.PartNumber, pm.PartNumberRev, pn.Description, rd.RouteId, rd.OperationNumber, rd.OperationId, pm.EWO, woof.FmaResult as FmaId, case when fs.Url is null then woof.Url else fs.url+'/show_bug.cgi?id='+woof.FmaResult end as FmaUrl, wo.OriginalWorkOrder, co.StartDate, co.CompleteDate, co.PassFail, co.EmployeeId, co.LastUpdateDate, pm.PartStatus FROM CurrentOperation co INNER JOIN WorkOrder wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.WorkOrderNum=co.WorkOrderNum INNER JOIN RouteDetail rd WITH (NOLOCK) ON rd.RouteId=wo.RouteId and rd.OperationNumber=co.Sequence and InactiveDate is null INNER JOIN PartMaster pm WITH (NOLOCK) ON pm.PartId=wo.PartId INNER JOIN PartNumber pn WITH (NOLOCK) ON pm.PartNumber=pn.PartNumber AND pm.PartNumberRev=pn.PartNumberRev LEFT JOIN WorkOrderOperationFma woof ON woof.WorkOrderNum=wo.WorkOrderNum AND woof.RouteId=rd.RouteId AND woof.OperationNumber=rd.OperationNumber AND woof.OperationId=rd.OperationId LEFT JOIN FmaServer fs WITH (NOLOCK) ON fs.FmaServer=woof.url WHERE co.rn = 1 order by wo.OriginalWorkOrder

ACTION.NAME: READ_BY_WORKORDER_NUMBER
ACTION.STATEMENT: SELECT MrsiParts.*,wo.PartId as AssemblyPartId,wo.RouteId,woo.OperationNumber FROM ( SELECT t.MrsiProgramRunPartsId, ( SELECT TOP 1 SubLot.Node.value('.', 'VARCHAR(100)') FROM MrsiProgramRunParts SubTable CROSS APPLY (SELECT CAST(SubTable.Parts AS XML)) AS SubConv(CleanXml) CROSS APPLY SubConv.CleanXml.nodes('//VendorLot') AS SubLot(Node) WHERE SubTable.MrsiProgramRunPartsId = t.MrsiProgramRunPartsId ) AS WorkOrderNum, ( SELECT TOP 1 SubLot.Node.value('.', 'VARCHAR(100)') FROM MrsiProgramRunParts SubTable CROSS APPLY (SELECT CAST(SubTable.Parts AS XML)) AS SubConv(CleanXml) CROSS APPLY SubConv.CleanXml.nodes('//TrayX') AS SubLot(Node) WHERE SubTable.MrsiProgramRunPartsId = t.MrsiProgramRunPartsId ) AS SlotPosition, LotRows.Node.value('../PartId[1]', 'VARCHAR(50)') AS PartId, LotRows.Node.value('.', 'VARCHAR(100)') AS VendorLot FROM MrsiProgramRunParts t CROSS APPLY ( SELECT CAST(t.Parts AS XML) AS CleanXml ) AS Converted CROSS APPLY Converted.CleanXml.nodes('//VendorLot') AS LotRows(Node) WHERE MrsiProgramRunId >=10258 ) MrsiParts INNER JOIN WorkOrder wo on wo.WorkOrderNum=MrsiParts.WorkOrderNum INNER JOIN PartMaster pm on pm.VendorLot=MrsiParts.VendorLot INNER JOIN WorkOrderOperation woo ON woo.WorkOrderNum=wo.WorkOrderNum and Sequence = (SELECT MAX(woom.Sequence) FROM WorkOrderOperation woom WHERE woom.WorkOrderNum = wo.WorkOrderNum AND woom.CompleteDate is null) INNER JOIN RouteOperationBOM rob ON rob.RouteId=wo.RouteId and rob.OperationNumber=woo.OperationNumber and rob.OperationId=woo.OperationId and rob.PartNumber=pm.PartNumber WHERE MrsiParts.workordernum <> MrsiParts.vendorlot AND (wo.WorkOrderNum IN @WorkOrderNumbers OR wo.WorkOrderNum LIKE @WorkOrderNumberWildCard OR wo.OriginalWorkOrder IN @OriginalWorkOrders OR wo.OriginalWorkOrder LIKE @OriginalWorkOrderWildCard) ORDER BY MrsiParts.workordernum,MrsiParts.partid
